gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-002 identifies the incorrect Racah summand ratio at eq:ratio_Rz, including the reversed product roles and the shifted b_y-(z+1) factor, and supplies the corrected ratio. That same shifted denominator is the source of the terminal zero-denominator failure, while the corrected formula restores the summand update.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: Both entries diagnose that the displayed ratio does not equal the quotient of consecutive Racah summands, so compilation fails to track the summands; the exact corrected formula also removes the shifted endpoint denominator that becomes [0]_q.

component_coverage.gold_component: The displayed ratio has the numerator and denominator product roles reversed and uses the wrong shift in the b_y factors, so it is not the quotient of consecutive Racah summands.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: ISSUE-002 gives the same consecutive-term quotient, explicitly identifies the reversed products and b_y-(z+1) shift, and provides the corrected ratio.

component_coverage.gold_component: The shifted old denominator becomes [0]_q at the final update for a nontrivial range, making the literal update undefined and invalidating the resulting compilation.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: ISSUE-002 explicitly identifies the shifted b_y-(z+1) denominator as part of the erroneous displayed ratio and supplies its replacement by the unshifted [b_y-z]_q numerator, thereby diagnosing the same terminal denominator defect and its effect on the update.

gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-004 concerns the existence of a required square root in the target field during projection. Gold I002 instead concerns non-determinacy of evaluation because the declared target field does not specify a nonzero image of q or an evaluation homomorphism; the square-root hypothesis does not supply that missing datum.
